title: terragucci.changes/v1
description: changes.json in a project's directory of a reports prefix: one row per resource each applied tf-apply wave changed, newest first. Actions and attribute names, never a value. Within v1 fields are only added, and an existing field never changes meaning.

attributes.description: The top-level attributes an update or a replacement changed, by name.

path.description: The wave's run directory, relative to the project's index.json.

plan_digest.description: The root's plan digest: the plan that applied.

set_digest.description: The wave's set digest, which its approval binds.
